title: Debate rages over U-M’s plan to hide letter grades. Here’s what to know
summary_en: Starting in the fall of 2027, first-year students at the College of Literature, Science and the Arts will no longer have their first-semester grades factored into their GPAs or written on transcripts. Students are split on if it’s a good idea.
author: Isabel Lohman
title_cn: Debate rages over U-M’s plan to hide letter grades. Here’s what to know
